card.name: Words just before a dependent-on phrase
card.fires_on: Scattered positions in clinical and general text, often a word that is about to be followed by a link such as 'on', 'of' or a number. Examples are 'dependent' before 'on opioids' and 'renin' inside renin-angiotensin.

modes.label: Dependence wording
modes.description: The word 'dependent' or 'depend' where 'on' is expected next.
modes.example: To prevent occurrence of precipitated withdrawal in patients<< dependent>> on opioids

modes.label: Partway through renin or microglia
modes.description: The middle of a term such as renin-angiotensin or microglia.
modes.example: In patients whose renal function may depend on the activity of the ren<<in>>-angiotensin system

modes.label: Before a number or measure
modes.description: A word or space just before a baseline value or approximate figure.
modes.example: At baseline the mean weight for children was<< >>39.0 kg for sertr
